name: Void Dire Shark
body:
VOID DIRE SHARK
CR 10

The matte black hide of this gigantic predator blots out the faint light of distant stars as it glides silently forward.

XP 9,600
N Gargantuan animal (aquatic)
Init +6; Senses blindsense 30 ft., scent“>keen scent, low-light vision; Perception +25

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 8, flat-footed 21 (+2 Dex, +15 natural, –4 size)
hp 112 (15d8+45)
Fort +14, Ref +13, Will +8
DR 15/magic and piercing; Resist cold 10; Immune radiation

OFFENSE

Speed swim 60 ft., fly 60 ft. (average)
Melee bite +17 (4d10+15/19–20 plus grab)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks swallow whole (2d6+15 damage, AC 17, 11 hp)

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 15, Con 17, Int 1, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +11; CMB +25 (+29 grapple); CMD 37
Feats Bleeding Critical, Critical Focus, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Perception +25, Swim +18
SQ no breath, starflight

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Starflight (Su)

A void dire shark can survive in the void of outer space. It flies through space at incredible speeds.

ECOLOGY

Environment outer space
Organization solitary
Treasure none

This nightmare of the void hunts its prey among asteroid belts and the upper atmospheres of gas giants. The void shark will attack and eat anything smaller than itself and anything larger that seems vulnerable, including shuttles and other small vessels. A void shark is 60 feet long and weighs 100,000 pounds.
